scripts.contracts:generate: openapi-typescript ../../contracts/openapi/identity-service.v1.yaml -o src/lib/api/generated/identity.ts && openapi-typescript ../../contracts/openapi/api-gateway.v1.yaml -o src/lib/api/generated/gateway.ts && openapi-typescript ../../contracts/openapi/assistant-service.v1.yaml -o src/lib/api/generated/assistant.ts
scripts.contracts:check: pnpm contracts:generate && git ls-files --error-unmatch src/lib/api/generated/identity.ts src/lib/api/generated/gateway.ts src/lib/api/generated/assistant.ts && git diff --exit-code -- src/lib/api/generated
scripts.build: tsc -b --pretty false && vite build && node scripts/verify-built-security-policy.mjs
